remote.name: Remote Name
remote.oauth_token_tooltip:
1. Install rclone on your local machine
2. Run rclone authorize "{type}"
3. Paste the token JSON here after completing browser auth
remote.fill_required: Please fill in name and type
remote.invalid_name: Name can only contain letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens
remote.confirm_delete_with_rules:
Delete remote "{name}"?
{count} rule(s) reference this storage and will also be deleted.
remote.deleted_with_rules: "{name}" deleted, {count} rule(s) referencing it cleaned up

oauth.open_auth_page: Open Authorization Page in New Tab
oauth.localhost_hint: After granting access, the browser will land on a localhost page that fails to open — this is expected. Copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it below.
oauth.google_unverified_hint: With a Google account you may see an "unverified app" warning page — click "Continue"; this behaves the same as a local rclone authorize.
oauth.paste_placeholder: Paste the full URL from the browser address bar
oauth.done_hint: Token is ready. Click "Create Remote" to finish (a connectivity test runs automatically).
oauth.drive_client_hint: rclone's built-in shared client_id is being retired during 2026 — providing your own Google Cloud client_id / client_secret is recommended (optional):
oauth.invalid_callback: Invalid callback URL: copy the full address from the browser address bar after authorizing and try again
oauth.session_active: An authorization session is already in progress — restoring its state
oauth.session_active_other: An authorization session for another provider ({type}) is in progress; finish or cancel it first
oauth.session_lost: Authorization session expired (dashboard may have restarted); please start again
oauth.poll_failed: Failed to poll authorization status; please start again
oauth.onedrive_enterprise_hint: For OneDrive business/team drives, auto-matching the main drive is not supported yet — use WebDAV or a locally configured rclone instead

rule.name: Rule Name
rule.method_help:
Copy: adds only, never deletes
Mirror sync: extras on the target get deleted
Move: source files are deleted after transfer

rule.run_ok: Rule started. Check logs for progress
